dev.description: Network interface to listen on. Empty string means default interface.

match_expression.description: Extended regular expression (PCRE2) to match against packet payloads.

bpf_filter.description: BPF filter expression to select packets (e.g., 'host 1.2.3.4').

num_packets.description: Match only this many packets total, then exit. 0 means no limit.

snaplen.description: BPF caplen to set the maximum number of bytes to capture per packet.

limitlen.description: Upper limit on packet size to analyze. 0 means no limit.

output_mode.description: Display mode: normal, byline, single, or none.

trailing_context.description: Number of packets of trailing context to dump after a match.

input_file.description: Input pcap dump file. If set, ngrep runs in offline mode.

output_file.description: Output pcap dump file for matched packets.

non_printable_char.description: Character to use for non-printable bytes in output.

drop_privs.description: If true, ngrep drops privileges after opening the interface. If false, it retains root.
